<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk">

  <PropertyGroup>
    <!-- Override default multi-targeting if needed -->
    <!-- TargetFrameworks inherited from Directory.Build.props -->
    <RootNamespace>Yubico.YubiKit.Core</RootNamespace>
    <AssemblyName>Yubico.YubiKit.Core</AssemblyName>

    <!-- Package Metadata -->
    <Description>Core library for Yubico.NET.SDK providing device management, connection abstractions, and APDU protocol handling for YubiKey devices.</Description>
    <PackageTags>yubikey;yubico;smartcard;fido2;authentication;hardware-security;apdu;pcsc</PackageTags>

    <!-- Allow unsafe code for performance-critical operations -->
    <AllowUnsafeBlocks>true</AllowUnsafeBlocks>

    <!-- Opts this published library into the shared Native AOT analyzer and metadata properties. -->
    <IsYubiKitSdkLibrary>true</IsYubiKitSdkLibrary>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <!-- Package versions come from Directory.Packages.props -->
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.Abstractions" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging" />
    <PackageReference Include="Yubico.NativeShims" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Explicit InternalsVisibleTo for legacy project names -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Core.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="MacOSHidRouteVerification" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="LinuxHidRouteVerification" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Tests.Shared" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Ctap2" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Management" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!--
    Applet modules whose IYubiKey.Create<App>SessionAsync entry points open a connection the caller never
    sees, and so must hand its ownership to the session they return (ApplicationSession.OwnConnection).
    Internal rather than public: transferring connection ownership is not something an SDK consumer needs,
    and every consumer-facing path already has a clear owner.
  -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Oath" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.OpenPgp" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Piv" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.SecurityDomain" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.YubiHsm" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.YubiOtp" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Applet tests that directly exercise their internal protocol-backed implementations. -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="DynamicProxyGenAssembly2" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Ctap2.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Management.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.Piv.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.SecurityDomain.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.YubiOtp.UnitTests" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

<Project>
  <!--
    Native AOT support surface (SDK libraries only).

    IsYubiKitSdkLibrary is an explicit per-project opt-in, set in every published SDK library
    .csproj. It defaults to false (Directory.Build.props) so CLI tools, example apps, and test
    projects are never silently pulled into the AOT support envelope. The opt-in is not optional:
    `dotnet toolchain.cs native-aot-contract-qa` discovers the SDK libraries from the
    src/<Module>/src/*.csproj layout and fails the build naming any that lacks it.

    This block lives in Directory.Build.targets, not Directory.Build.props: props files are
    imported before a project's own <PropertyGroup>, so a project-level
    `<IsYubiKitSdkLibrary>true</IsYubiKitSdkLibrary>` opt-in would not yet be visible to a
    conditional block evaluated that early. Targets files are imported after the project body, so
    the flag is guaranteed to be set by the time this condition is evaluated.

    Setting IsAotCompatible=true also enables the trimming, AOT, and single-file analyzers.

    VerifyReferenceAotCompatibility=true surfaces IL3058 for a referenced managed dependency that
    lacks AOT-compatibility metadata. The repository does not suppress that diagnostic.
  -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(IsYubiKitSdkLibrary)' == 'true'">
    <IsAotCompatible>true</IsAotCompatible>
    <VerifyReferenceAotCompatibility>true</VerifyReferenceAotCompatibility>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Add common analyzer packages to all projects -->
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers">
      <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
      <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers</IncludeAssets>
    </PackageReference>
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(IsYubiKitSdkLibrary)' == 'true'">
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.PublicApiAnalyzers">
      <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
      <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers</IncludeAssets>
    </PackageReference>
    <AdditionalFiles Include="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/PublicAPI.Shipped.txt" />
    <AdditionalFiles Include="$(MSBuildProjectDirectory)/PublicAPI.Unshipped.txt" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <!-- Shared Internals Visibility for non-test projects -->
  <ItemGroup Condition="'$(IsTestProject)' != 'true'">
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="$(AssemblyName).UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="$(AssemblyName).IntegrationTests" />
    <!-- Legacy compatibility -->
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.UnitTests" />
    <InternalsVisibleTo Include="Yubico.YubiKit.IntegrationTests" />
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
